== Ingredients ==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Onion Powder|onion powder]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chilli powder]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] drumsticks

== Equipment ==
*[[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]
*[[Cookbook:Paper Towel|Paper towels]]
*[[Cookbook:Baking Dish|Baking dish]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine the paprika, onion powder, chili powder, and salt together in a bowl.
#Preheat oven to 400°F.
#Pat the chicken dry with paper towels. 
#Coat the chicken with oil and the prepared spice blend, ensuring all sides are well-coated. Transfer to a baking dish.
#Bake the chicken drumsticks until the skin is brown and crispy (about 25 minutes).
#Serve hot.
